_comment: Settings for the scheduled jobs on the platform host (WD-181). Copy outside the kit's folder, fill in every <placeholder>, and keep the copy in the run's folder, which only the run account and the host's Tier 0 administrators can read. No secret goes in this file: the reader app signs in with the certificate file named here.
clientId: <help desk audit reader app's application id>
subscriptionId: <subscription holding the Arc machines and the workspace>
